w: 197 years ago, Lord Swaminarayan announced the Swaminarayan mantra for His devotees. To celebrate its Bicentenary, the Sanstha has arranged a three-year program. The announcement of the programs was to be made in Swamishri’s morning puja. The backdrop had a banner and the name ‘Swaminarayan’ written in different colours. During Swamishri’s puja, the sadhus sang bhajans glorifying the Swaminarayan mantra. Pujya Viveksagar Swami spoke on the glory and history of the Swaminarayan Mahamantra. Today, a 24-hour programme of chanting the Swaminaryan maha-mantra was to be launched by Swamishri. The occasion was inaugurated with the lighting of a lamp by Swamishri and then he addressed the gathering,

"Bhagwan Swaminarayan came on earth with His divine abode, muktas and divine powers. And when Ramanand Swami passed away he declared the ‘Swaminarayan’ mantra for all. The glory of this mantra is unique. By saying it one becomes free of physical and mental illness and ultimately one becomes blessed with God’s divine abode. Whenever any national or social problems arise, Yogiji Maharaj used to chant the Swaminarayan mantra.

"This mantra has been given to us by Bhagwan Swaminarayan, therefore we should chant it to please God. We should engage ourselves according to our suitability and degree of faith. Now let us chant the Swaminarayan mantra..."

And Swamishri, with eyes closed and absorbed in God, began chanting Swaminarayan, Swaminarayan. The devotees chorused the mantra and the atmosphere was charged with divinity. For seven minutes Swamishri chanted the mantra.
Swamishri left Nadiad at 5.40 pm, stopped at Chhani for a while and then reached Atladra at 8.05 pm.

At 7.00 pm, Swamishri arrived at the newly built mandir in Avondale. For the ritual opening, Swamishri released a bunch of balloons amidst joyous clappings. Then Vedic verses were sung while Swamishri performed pujan of the mandir entrance and inaugurated the opening of the mandir by untying the ribbon. Then Swamishri sanctified various parts of the mandir. During the welcome assembly, the kishores of Auckland performed the welcome dance. Shri Durlabhbhai Patel, Chairman of BAPS Auckland, gave a welcome speech and thereafter various leading devotees offered bouquets to Swamishri. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.

On arriving at the Swaminarayan Chhatralay, 800 devotees from different villages of Khandesh region welcomed Swamishri. Shri Dhanrajbhai Patil, an aged devotee from the time of Shastriji Maharaj, welcomed Swamishri by presenting a kalash and coconut. Thereafter the devotees got the opportunity of Swamishri's darshan from nearby as they filed passed.

In the evening, from 5.00 p.m. Pujya Viveksagar Swami addressed the assembly in Hindi. The members of the Dhuliya Bal Mandal performed a welcome dance. Thereafter garlands were offered to Swamishri. The assembly concluded with Swamishri's blessings in Hindi.
At 10.00 a.m., Swamishri departed from New Delhi airport and arrived in Dhuliya at 12.35 p.m.

A young doctor fell in love with a south Indian girl through website chatting. His father disapproved of his relationship and brought him to Swamishri. While describing the situation the father broke down crying. Swamishri explained to the youth, “Your first duty is to your parents. They have endured great difficulties in raising you, therefore it is your duty to ask them before you decide upon anything. If you had asked them earlier and if they had approved then it would have been alright. But your parents do not sanction your decision, therefore you must tell the girl that you do not want to continue your relationship further. Tell her your parents are not happy with your decision. I give you my blessings for a suitable match.” Then Swamishri asked the youth, “What do you have to say? Say what you want without any reservation. There is no need to be frustrated. And don’t spoil the life of the girl you will marry because of this.” The youth replied, “I will do what you say.” Swamishri promotes the social tradition of parental authority, where the child should always consult and obey their wishes, but not displease them.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
1 February 2005, Surat

Students of Akshar Purushottam Chhatralay (APC) performed various austerities to please Swamishri: 17 students performed an 84-hour waterless fast, 81 students performed 84 hours of fasting with water only, 62 students collectively performed 84,000 rosaries (mala), 44 students performed 8,400 rosaries by standing on one leg as a symbol of austerity, 53 students had collectively performed 84,000 dandvats, 61 students collectively performed 84,000 pradakshinas, 58 students collectively performed 8,4000 chantings of Janmangal Namavali, 8 students collectively accomplished 8,400 writings of the Swaminarayan mantra.
7 February 2005, Atladra
Six students of APC performed an 84-hour waterless fast to please Swamishri.
10 February 2005, Atladra

For Swamishri’s good health 14 women devotees observed a waterless fast for 85 hours, 246 women observed a lemon-water fast for 85 hours, 343 women performed 85 rosaries every day, 311 women recited Janmangal Namavali 85 times , 85 women performed a waterless fast for one day.
12 February 2005, Atladra

For Swamishri’s good health young women devotees performed various austerities. Sixty-eight ladies observed 85 hours of fasting with water, eight ladies performed a waterless fast for 85 hours, 171 ladies performed 85 rosaries each daily, 217 ladies pledged to chant the Janmangal Namavali 85 times, 134 ladies performed a waterless fast and 84 ladies pilgrimaged by foot from their homes to the mandir.
19 February 2005, Atladra
For Swamishri’s good health 1,100 devotees observed a waterless fast today. A youth of Shiyabaug performed 30,733 dandvats in 17 days.

Today, Dr Ashwinbhai Mehta declared the reports to Swamishri on his Thalium test. He said that the reports were normal, and considering his age he should not take any extra strain or exert himself in his daily routine. He also advised that Swamishri should continue his daily routine of walking.
Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of puja and arti of the murtis for the BAPS hari mandir in Bavla.
The son of Jha Saheb, owner of the daily newspaper Gandhinagar Samachar, asked Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "How can one have peace in personal life?"

Swamishri said, "By devotion to God, by taking his refuge and by continuing to worship him, one has peace. The scriptures say that peace is only at the feet of God. So if we take his firm refuge, God, being the abode of peace, will give us peace too. Do five malas every day and pray."

Amrutbhai Patel, who had come from Cherry Hill, was leaving today. When he came for Pramukh Swami Maharaj's darshan he held out his hands, and Swamishri took his hand. This divine experience thrilled him. He said, "Just keep holding our hand like this."
Swamishri said, "If we do not let go of God, God will not let go of us. When a ghost clings to someone it does not let go, so how will God let go?"
The son of a devotee named Ashokbhai had come for darshan. After the darshan, seeing his bare forehead, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Apply tilak and chandlo (the sacred forehead mark)."
The young man said to Swamishri, "Today I came having resolved that if Bapa told me himself, I would apply tilak and chandlo, and you have caught my resolve."
This is Swamishri's all-knowing nature.

The young man told Swamishri, "Today I came having decided that if Bapa himself tells me, I will do tilak chandlo, and you caught my wish."
This is Swamishri's knowing of hearts.

ds.t: Words of inspiration on the phone
w: In the car from Sarangpur to Vidyanagar

A seeker had received permission from his parents to become a sadhu, but other relatives were still somewhat unsure. When Mahant Swami Maharaj was travelling from Sarangpur to Vidyanagar, he showered wonderful words of inspiration on this family by phone:

"Shriji Maharaj has said that we have taken countless births. Is that true or false? So in countless births we have had countless mothers and fathers. Your mother may have been your daughter, your mother in law, anything at all... Over countless births we have formed all sorts of relationships, back and forth. Tell me if that is wrong. So all those relationships of countless births are false, and Shriji Maharaj has said, 'The relationship with Shri Hari is true; everything else is fleeting and fragile.' If this is true, should we think about it or not? So we should offer him at the feet of God. And God is manifest; if he were not, it would be a different matter. Giving to one who is not present, if God were not present, would be different, but he is manifest. So if we see him as merely human, thinking 'he is a human being', then that is the end of it; though we met him in person, it is as if we had not met him, nothing remains. So we must understand this and keep this understanding."
Swami's talk came to mind: "The father has a wife in his heart, so he gets his son married; the Sadhu has God in his heart, so he places God in the heart of the soul."
